name: com.agentstackd/directory
title: AgentStackd AI Agent Directory
description: Search and compare 77 hand-reviewed AI agents and tools: pricing model, limitations and sources.

tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search the AgentStackd directory of hand-reviewed AI agents and automation tools by keyword. Optional filters: category slug and max_price tier. Returns matching tools with pricing model, description and the agentstackd.com page URL.

max_price.description: Optional pricing ceiling: 'free' = Free or Open source only; 'freemium' = also tools with a free plan; 'paid' = everything. The directory records pricing models, not dollar amounts.

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Get one tool's AgentStackd listing: pricing model, description, pros, limitations, vendor sources (with the date they were checked), related comparisons and the agentstackd.com page URL. Accepts a slug or a partial name (e.g. 'Copilot'). If nothing matches, the error includes 'did you mean' suggestions.

slug.description: Tool slug or name (e.g. 'cursor', 'claude-code', 'Copilot'). Partial names are OK.

tools.name: compare_tools
tools.description: Compare 2 or 3 tools side by side: category, pricing model, pros, limitations and sources, plus any AgentStackd head-to-head comparison page that covers them. Partial names are OK. If some names are not listed, returns the tools that were found plus a not_listed array with suggestions.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List AgentStackd categories with descriptions, tool counts and page URLs.

tools.name: new_releases
tools.description: Recently released AI tools added to AgentStackd, with the vendor's release date and page URL.
